title: Senior Program Manager, SSD R2L Delivery, Central Operations Strategy
description:
The Central Operations Strategy organization is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to own weather and incident response strategy for our last-mile delivery network. Weather is one of the largest drivers of unplanned variability in our operations, and this role owns the mechanisms that determine how we respond to it: how much capacity we protect, how much volume we accept, and how quickly we recover when conditions differ from what was forecast.
This role sits at the intersection of operations strategy and data. The Sr. Program Manager will build and own the reporting and analysis that show how weather affects delivery performance, translate weather forecasts into clear capacity recommendations, and measure whether those recommendations improved outcomes. They will partner closely with our central response team, meteorologists, and business stakeholders to land the right balance between volume and delivery quality for every event, and to improve the quality of the inputs driving those decisions over time.
The role requires strong program ownership and comfort making decisions with imperfect information. The ideal candidate can dig into the data to find the answer, then turn it into a clear recommendation and a durable process that operations teams can run every day.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the framework that measures how weather affects delivery quality and capacity, and the recurring reporting built on it
- Build and maintain the models and analysis that turn weather forecasts into capacity and volume recommendations grounded in historical performance
- Measure forecast accuracy and recommendation effectiveness, and drive improvements from what you find
- Partner with our central response team to improve response playbooks, escalation paths, and recovery actions for planned and unplanned events
- Partner with meteorologists to improve forecasting, feeding operational outcomes back into how forecasts are built
- Own the volume-versus-quality trade-off recommendation, sizing the cost of both over-reacting and under-reacting
- Build the tools and processes that let this program scale across the network
- Influence investment priorities through data-driven business cases, and drive alignment across operations, planning, finance, and technology partners
- Communicate strategy, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership
Demonstrated Competencies
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently with large data sets; SQL and - Python preferred
- High judgment with incomplete information
- Track record of building programs or reporting capabilities from scratch
- Willingness to go deep in an unfamiliar, technically complex domain and become the expert others rely on
- Proven ability to build consensus and drive decisions across large, diverse stakeholder groups
- Ability to simplify complexity for senior audiences
- Confidence in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
A day in the life
You start by reviewing how the network performed against recent weather events, and where results missed, working backwards to whether the fix belongs in the forecast, the recommendation, or execution. You spend part of the day in the data, refining the analysis behind our capacity recommendations and quantifying trade-offs. You partner with the central response team to prepare for upcoming events and with meteorologists to review where forecasts diverged from outcomes. The rest of your time goes to building mechanisms rather than reacting: better reporting, less manual work, and the documents that take your recommendations to senior leadership.

title: Senior Program Manager, Technology Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement
description:
Amazon's Technology Supply Chain is scaling, and the hardest part of that growth is getting an entire organization to change how it works. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain and make new ways of working the way the organization operates by default. You will design adoption approaches grounded in established change management methodologies such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter's 8-Step, build the communications that move behavior, and decide what to do when adoption stalls. You are comfortable in ambiguity and able to influence leaders and teams you do not manage. Success in this role is adoption: the standards you introduce become how teams actually operate. You will start with changes already in flight and build a discipline that applies to whichever change the organization adopts next. Over time the role grows. You will deepen expertise in change management and AI-assisted operations, and your scope will widen from driving individual changes to shaping how the whole organization absorbs change.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the change management discipline across Technology Supply Chain, partnering with leadership to shape the change strategy and owning its execution. Apply stakeholder analysis, readiness assessment, and resistance management to determine goals and design adoption approaches in ambiguous situations where the problem is not yet fully defined.
- Build adoption frameworks, playbooks, communications, and enablement materials that take each new way of working from something that exists to something the organization does by default, drawing on established change frameworks such as Prosci/ADKAR and Kotter.
- Partner with reporting, governance, and tooling teams to drive adoption of shared ways of working across all customer groups, influencing leaders and teams you do not directly manage to align on how the organization operates.
- Establish adoption measurement and reporting so progress and risk are visible before a change fails, own the judgment on how to respond when adoption stalls, and build the documentation and processes that make new ways of working durable beyond any single individual.
A day in the life
You spend your day building the organization's capacity to change. You partner with leadership to shape the change strategy, then own how it comes to life: assessing why change stalls and fixing it at the root rather than rescuing one rollout at a time. You coach leaders to be effective sponsors of the changes they own, because that is where change succeeds or fails. You sequence a portfolio of concurrent changes so the organization adopts them without saturating, and build the methodology and standards that let every team run change well. You work across every Technology Supply Chain group and influence leaders you do not manage. Your real product is not any single rollout. It is an organization that can change without breaking.
About the team
Technology Supply Chain delivers the full lifecycle of technology fulfillment for Amazon, sourcing, delivering, and deploying the hardware, infrastructure, and equipment that Amazon's Worldwide Stores operations and AWS data centers run on. As Amazon's technology footprint grows, Technology Supply Chain is the organization that keeps the supply chain behind it ahead of demand. Our team is the central program management and business operations function within Technology Supply Chain. Our principle is "enable rather than simply do": we take recurring programmatic work off every team through shared standards, processes, and tooling so each team can focus on the specialized work only it can do, and we build our own automation to do it.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications: - 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Cloudscape
description:
AWS ships over 280 services and more than 50 off-console applications. Every one carries a full surface area — APIs, SDK, CLI, console, documentation, infrastructure-as-code support, identity integration, logging, monitoring, pricing, and regional availability. Producing and maintaining these interfaces consumes enormous engineering capacity, and the quality customers experience is uneven.
Managed Interfaces changes the model: when customer needs change, AWS responds in weeks, not months. Every interface a customer touches is generated from one source of truth — the service's API model — and stays consistent as the service evolves. Builders launch new services with near-zero effort on undifferentiated engineering, and user testing starts at the beginning of a project, when changes are cheap.
You will own the program management for this effort, coordinating three workstreams: agentic capabilities for builders, the managed console experience, and the agents that keep documentation and downstream channels current. This is a cross-organizational role that turns a multi-year north star into shippable, measurable proof points.
Key job responsibilities
Drive the program end-to-end. Own the roadmap, milestones, and dependencies across all three workstreams, translating the 2027 north star into quarterly deliverables and committed proof points.
Coordinate across teams. Align the UX platform, launch orchestration, console generation, the context layer, and 200+ service teams whose consoles move to the managed path. Resolve cross-team dependencies and sequencing conflicts before they become blockers.
Manage the proof-point scoreboard. Define, track, and report the metrics that demonstrate progress: services registered to the context layer, consoles converted to managed, undifferentiated effort reduced per feature, automated quality improvements shipped per month, task-completion times, and accessibility violations trending to zero.
Communicate up and across. Produce clear status, risk, and decision documents for senior leadership; run operational reviews; and keep stakeholders aligned on scope, trade-offs, and timelines.
Manage risk. Surface technical and organizational risks early — adoption friction, capability gaps for off-console applications, source-of-truth consistency — and drive mitigation.
A day in the life
A single integrated roadmap across the three workstreams with clear ownership and dependencies.
A live scoreboard tracking the committed proof points, reviewed on a regular operating cadence.
The first managed-console conversions in production, moving from one prototype toward a repeatable path.
An adoption plan for moving the standard console path to managed by default, with onboarding support for service teams.

The Cloudscape team builds the design system that powers the AWS Management Console - one of the most-used enterprise interfaces in the world. We're a multidisciplinary team of 35+ spanning UX design, front-end engineering, research, and program management. We ship 114+ components, maintain comprehensive design guidance, and build AI-powered tools that help teams build faster. Our work directly impacts millions of AWS customers and hundreds of service teams.

Accurately monitoring the health of every application and infrastructure that comprises the Apple ecosystem 100% of the time is an order of magnitude more challenging. As a Site Reliability Engineer on the Observability Team, you will champion the availability, performance, and scaling of customer-facing production services, ensuring customers worldwide experience seamless, lightning-fast, and uninterrupted service. description:

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area with minimum 10 years of proven experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

title: ML - Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to decide whether a generative imaging feature is good enough to ship? Our team evaluates generative image and video features. These features reach a very large number of people on Apple devices. You will build the evaluation systems, human-annotation programs, and automated metrics that turn "this looks better" into measurable, trustworthy quality signals. Those signals guide model development and release decisions.
You'll own quality evaluation end to end — from evaluation set design through annotation, scoring, analysis, and the recommendations that shape what engineering and product build next. Your findings determine which models ship.
What you'll do
Build the measurement foundation. Design and maintain golden sets and evaluation sets, analyzing data distributions so results stay representative and known defects stay covered.
Run human evaluation at quality. Write and iterate annotation guidelines and label schemas, build or adapt lightweight labeling tools for image and video review, monitor annotator quality, and resolve disagreements and guideline ambiguity.
Automate the repeatable parts. Develop automated metrics and LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and track where they diverge.
Make the results decision-ready. Report model-vs-model comparisons with confidence intervals, significance testing, and breakdowns by hotspot, content type, and failure mode — then turn them into root-cause findings and prioritized recommendations.
Set the bar with your partners. Work with ML, engineering, and design to define quality standards, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Minimum qualifications: MS and a minimum of 5 years relevant industry experience
5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, algorithm analysis, or related technical disciplines.
Experience designing and analyzing evaluations and experiments, especially for ML or generative model quality. This includes sampling design, significance testing, and confidence intervals.
Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL, with the ability to build and maintain evaluation pipelines and small tools.
Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis workflows, foundation models, agentic systems, or intelligent automation approaches for technical problem solving.
Preferred qualifications: Experience evaluating 3D Gaussian splats or diffusion models, or assessing perceptual quality.
Experience building LLM or VLM judges and validating them against human ratings.

title: Senior Security Engineering Manager - Agentic Detection & Threat Hunting

The two halves depend on each other, and the speed of the feedback loop between them is one of the team's greatest strengths.
We are looking for a Senior Manager who is a builder first. This role is technical and hands-on. You will manage a team of experienced engineers, and you will work as a close peer with the manager of the on-host agent team. You will work with partner teams across Apple's security organization on delivery, platform dependencies and operations. title: Senior Security Software Engineer EDR
description:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding any threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.
A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.
We are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us grow this agent to protect a very large fleet, and to do it without ever taking production down. You will bring two things at once: the engineering depth to ship new capabilities quickly, and a reliability mindset that treats every release as something that runs on production hosts. You will take vague, high-stakes problems and turn them into working software, working with other teams to find out what to build and how. Personal proficiency, in at least one high-level or scripting language (Python or Rust) and at least one low-level systems language (C or C++).
Solid knowledge of operating system internals (processes, threads, memory, system calls, namespaces). Linux, macOS or both.

title: Systems Engineer - Evaluation Engineering
description:
Siri Agentic Evaluation Platform. Evaluation is no longer just a static test suite—it is a highly dynamic, massive-scale distributed problem. Our platform enables teams to run high-throughput agentic simulations, orchestrate multi-model judging pipelines, and generate real-time observability dashboards across billions of tokens and complex data types.
We are looking for a Distributed Systems Engineer to own the infrastructure powering our core
In this role, you will design the execution engine that coordinates these complex evaluation loops. You will build systems that remain deterministic, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient, even when coordinating massive parallel requests across heterogeneous device types(iPhones, Mac, iPads etc).
Minimum qualifications: MS in computer science or equivalent
7+ years of experience as distributed systems engineer, platform engineer or equivalent.
Systems & Backend Languages: Strong proficiency in languages optimized for concurrency and enterprise scale, such as Python (asyncio) or Java.

Experience building Agentic RAG platforms or developer-facing infrastructure tooling.

title: Technical Product Marketing Specialist, Canada & Latin America
description:

The Technical Product Marketing team provides direct technical management and operational support to the Apple Product Marketing organization. This includes support for product launches and press briefings, retail demo development, internal testing and demonstrations, product and feature investigations, and experiential marketing.
This role is part of the International Product Marketing organization, a group of experts who champion Apple products within their respective markets and find innovative ways to keep them at the heart of the customer conversation. The organization lays the foundation for Apple's peerless demonstrations, presentations, and briefings.
We are passionate about our products, and we are looking for a highly motivated individual to provide best-in-class technical support to our marketing initiatives.
Every Apple launch depends on demonstrations that work flawlessly. In this role, you will be the technical force behind them, turning new products into experiences that the media, external and internal partners can see, trust, and talk about.
You will bring deep knowledge of Apple platforms and a hands-on approach to a fast-moving environment where no two days look alike. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to make sure each launch is ready for the world stage.
This role suits a collaborative, self-directed problem solver who takes pride in the details that make a product shine.
Minimum qualifications: 2+ years of experience with both iOS and macOS, as well as Apple hardware
Experience with mass deployment techniques and best practices for iOS and macOS, as well as large-scale system administration
Strong knowledge of the macOS command line toolset, shell scripting, Python, and modern web technology codebases
Fluency in written and spoken English
Ability to travel up to 40% of the time, within the United States and internationally, including to Canada and Latin America
Preferred qualifications: Solid practical knowledge of networking hardware, software, and implementation best practices
A solution-oriented mindset and high-level programming skills
Excellent written and spoken communication skills, and the ability to tailor communication to different audiences
Experience building scalable databases
A creative and ambitious approach to problem-solving
Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

title: Test & Instrumentation Development Engineer
description:
The Instrumentation and Test technology team architects and designs best-in-class, end-to-end test and measurements systems.
We are a collaborative group of creative and thoughtful people developing highly complex and sophisticated systems to validate the performance of sensors and other critical technologies in our world-class products.
This individual will play a key role in designing comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and integrating the measurement systems to support new product introduction, characterization, ramp, and mass production. This includes everything from defining high level test plans to architecting the specific instruments required to execute them.
You will play a key role in architecting, designing, and deploying the complete test solutions—including hardware, software, and algorithms—for our next-generation products. Partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional teams, you will develop the critical test methodologies and instrumentation needed for system characterization, calibration, and validation in a fast-paced and collaborative product development environment.
Minimum qualifications: Our ideal candidate has experience in test integration, implementation, and has a strong foundation in at least one of the following core areas: system or application-level test software or instrumentation hardware design.
Minimum of bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) with 10 years of relevant industry experience in a hands-on technical role.
3+ years of experience in a programming language like C/C++ or Python
Preferred qualifications: End-to-end Test Design: Experience creating and documenting comprehensive test plans, defining test cases and coverage, and developing validation methodologies for complex systems.
International Travel: This role requires international travel (up to 25%) to support our manufacturing partners during key product builds. This typically involves 2-4 trips per year at sites in Asia. Our team is committed to providing as much advance notice as possible to support your planning.
Curiosity and Adaptability: You are driven by curiosity, energized by solving novel problems, and motivated to learn new skills to get the job done.
Focused Problem Solving: You excel at identifying the most critical variables in a complex system and can develop a clear, focused plan of action even when all the details are not yet available.
Hands-on experience with electronics debugging tools.
Electrical engineering fundamentals (ability to read schematics & layout & component datasheets).
You have experience developing robust software and algorithms in a modern object-oriented or scripting language (e.g., Python, C++). Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem is a plus but not required.
Background in testing high-volume consumer electronics, particularly with Touch, Sensing, Display, or other complex user-facing technologies.
Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) or image processing algorithms.
Experience with instrument camera and optical capture system is a plus.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and design teams.
Passion for learning and contributing across disciplines.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Excellent skills in debugging and performing failure analysis across software, hardware and system domains. Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies like Design of Experiments (DOE). Ability to perform and interpret statistical data analysis.
Master's degree preferred.

description:

title: Tools & Automation Backend Quality Engineer – App Store Analytics
description:
The App Store Analytics Quality Engineering team ensures the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of customer experience data that powers features and insights across the App Store ecosystem. We are seeking a test automation engineer with strong experience in Big Data environments (Spark, Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Hive, Iceberg), backend, and UI service testing and the ability to build scalable, robust test automation using Java or Python.
This role is central to ensuring quality throughout the data lifecycle — from client instrumentation to backend aggregation and reporting dashboard — by applying shift-left testing principles, embedding quality checks early in development, and integrating test automation within CI/CD pipelines.
In this role, you will drive quality for large-scale distributed data systems that power App Store analytics. You will collaborate closely with engineering, data, and program management teams to define test strategies, drive testing automation development, and ensure high data quality across ingestion, transformation, reporting, and UI layers. You will be responsible for:
* Implementing and maintaining automated validation frameworks for data pipelines, backend and frontend services.
* Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous feedback and early defect detection.
* Partnering with developers to shift quality left by embedding testability into data workflows, APIs, and UI dashboard.
* Ensuring consistency and correctness of client-to-backend data flows across iOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and Web.
This role requires a self-driven engineer with strong technical depth, solid analytical skills, and the ability to influence quality across complex, evolving systems.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar fields.
At least 7+ years industry experience in a similar role.
Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend, frontend, data pipeline test automation.
Working knowledge of SQL and large-scale dataset validation across distributed storage or data lake environments.
Experience with REST API testing and test automation.
Experience with UI testing and test automation.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing frameworks.
Proven experience implementing Shift-Left testing practices and embedding automation early in the SDLC.
Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.
Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with Big Data frameworks (Spark, Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Hive, Iceberg).
Hands-on experience with mobile testing.
Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Charles Proxy, Postman, or equivalent tools for API and network validation.
Exposure to iOS/macOS platforms and Swift (for end-to-end validation scenarios).
Passion for building maintainable, reusable, and scalable test automation systems.

title: US-Business Pro
description:

Have extensive business solutions experience with Apple products and services.
Be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken (sign language supported).
Preferred qualifications: You can:
Show a track record of strong performance and results in technology or business solutions sales.
Communicate effectively and tailor your communication style to different audiences.
Work in a fast-paced environment and make timely decisions, sometimes under tight deadlines and pressure.
Build rapport and work effectively with both internal and external customers, including business owners and executives.
Demonstrate excellent organizational and process management skills, the ability to set priorities, and responsiveness to customer requests.
Demonstrate excellent learning, negotiation, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Draw from advanced Apple expertise on mobility adoption and business transformation with general knowledge of key SMB industries, technology trends, and challenges.
Learn, navigate, and use new tools and systems.

title: Video Codec Algorithm Engineer
description:
At Apple, we craft experiences that are intuitive, powerful, and deeply personal. Video is central to this mission, powering everything from spectacular cinematic content on Apple TV+, seamless communication on FaceTime, and the groundbreaking camera capture capabilities and vibrant memories on iPhone. The innovation in video compression and processing algorithms isn't just a technical detail; it's the invisible magic that enables unparalleled visual quality, efficient delivery, and immersive user experiences across our entire product ecosystem. It's within this collaborative environment, where diverse imaginations come together to make each other’s ideas stronger, that we create something truly wonderful and share it with the world. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!
As a Video Codec Algorithm Engineer within our small and dynamic group, you will be at the forefront of innovation, tackling complex technical challenges and playing a key role in shaping the future of video experiences across Apple products. We are seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual with a deep passion for video coding and processing technologies, coupled with strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
Minimum qualifications: BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience.
Expertise in video and image coding principles, algorithms, and techniques.
In-depth knowledge of video compression standards such as H.264, HEVC.
Strong programming skills in C/C++.
Excellent software design, problem-solving, and debugging abilities.
Preferred qualifications: Experience with both objective and subjective visual quality assessment methods.
Understanding of hardware-based techniques with the ability to develop ideas that are hardware-friendly.
Familiarity with video processing algorithms (e.g., scaling, noise reduction, tone mapping) is a plus.
Proficiency in digital signal processing and information theory is a plus.
Knowledge of the latest computer vision and deep learning technologies, and their application to video processing, is a significant advantage.
Excellent collaboration skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Video Systems Specialist
description:
Worldwide Events and Experiences brings the best of Apple to life, showcasing our products, services and the values that drive our company. The team includes professionals with backgrounds in event design, management, operations, broadcast, and production. We’re looking for inventive and collaborative people from a variety of creative fields. If that’s you, then your next home may be here!
The Video Systems Specialist is a hands-on technical role supporting the delivery of premium live and broadcast experiences for Apple at Worldwide Events venues and remote locations. Acting as the team’s visual and display technical specialist, this role owns the end-to-end visual integrity, color fidelity, signal processing, and reliable operation of large- and small-format LED systems and video playback pipelines across rehearsals, live events, and broadcast productions.
The Video Systems Specialist collaborates across technical teams, producers, creative partners, and external vendors within Worldwide Events. Success in this role requires a sharp visual eye, deep technical rigor in display science and signal flow, and calm, precise execution in high-stakes, executive-facing environments with zero margin for error.

Working knowledge of professional LED processing platforms (e.g., Megapixel Helios, Brompton Tessera).
Solid grasp of video engineering fundamentals: signal flow (SDI, HDMI, fiber, SMPTE 2110), EDID, aspect ratios, pixel mapping, raster management, genlock, and frame-rates.
Direct experience operating Apple Keynote and playback hardware in a technical production environment.
Experience with live event media servers and screen management switchers (e.g., Barco E2/E3, Disguise, Pixera).
Proven ability to communicate visual and technical issues cross-functionally with creative, editorial, and executive-facing teams under pressure.
Preferred qualifications: Broadcast and on-camera LED display experience, including shutter angle synchronization, refresh rates, scan lines, and camera-to-display moiré mitigation.
Experience with live event media servers and screen management switchers (e.g., Disguise, Pixera
Background supporting high-profile keynote presentations, premium product launches, or studio broadcast environments.
Practical knowledge of physical screen engineering, including load distribution, ground-support systems, rigging safety, and power distribution.

title: Wireless Systems Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for wireless technologies? Do you want to impact the wireless experience for billions of users? Come and join us! You will become part of a hands-on development team that furthers engineering perfection, creativity, and innovation with a prime focus on wireless accuracy and performance. Dynamic, encouraging people and innovative technologies are the norm here. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!
Join Apple’s System RF organization and drive innovation that matters! We’re looking for engineers who will re-imagine the way wireless performance of a device is analyzed and work cross-functionally with teams to deliver the best in class wireless performance for our customers. Our engineers help architect, research, and design, Apple’s world-class wireless products. All members of the numerous teams within the organization bring their own unique expertise to collectively bring wireless technologies to our products, following Apple’s culture of excellence in engineering principles and practices.
The job role will entail wireless performance research focused primarily on understanding how various factors like antenna performance, modem performance, SAR, RF algorithms, user interaction with device, channel conditions, co-ex and interference will impact wireless performance and in turn the end user experience. You will use these findings to work with cross-functional teams to help drive antenna, wireless algorithms and system level design and architecture changes.
Minimum qualifications: Masters degree in Electrical or Telecommunications Engineering or equivalent.
Strong understanding of cellular, WiFi or GNSS technologies.
Test automation experience. Python preferred and fluency with AI tools.
Preferred qualifications: 3+ years industry experience in RF and/or wireless systems.
Experience working on physical layer wireless algorithms.
Strong background in wireless communications.
Capturing and analyzing baseband logs to root cause performance issues.

title: Wireless Systems Engineer
description:
At Apple, you will have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to deliver outstanding performance for wireless products. As a member of the Product RF Design team, you will be at the forefront of wireless technology as we push the boundaries of achievable performance in wireless for innovative products. You will become part of a hands-on product development team that shapes and influences current and future generations of Apple products. We’re looking for dedicated and motivated engineers with good fundamentals in one or more areas of RF/wireless and electromagnetic theory, antenna design, system integration, & wireless communications.
Product RF Design Engineers should have a broad-based knowledge in RF architecture, design, integration and manufacturing. They have deep theoretical and practical knowledge in one or more areas of electromagnetic theory, RF and Wireless circuit design, communication theory, and product design trade-off. They use electromagnetic and system simulation, hands on prototyping, test and measurement to understand complex system and sub-system interactions, implications to product level design, and manufacturing trade-offs to enable mass production.
Product RF Design Engineers apply their expertise in all aspects of product design from concept, architecture definition, integration and prototyping to final production. They work closely with wireless and software architects, industrial designers, and product designers to guide and sculpt the product design with an eye towards optimizing RF/Wireless functionality for the user. title: Market Analyst
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns a fleet of distributed batteries and the households we serve into a power business that makes money. As a Market Analyst, you’ll know how much Base is earning, where it could lose money, and how it will make money in the next market.

You’ll own P&L (profit and loss) reporting and risk tracking across our battery fleet and retail operations. You’ll build the pricing models behind what we charge members, recommend hedges, and work with Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy to figure out how Base makes money in each new market. Base already does this in ERCOT. Your first job is to do it in PJM.

This role suits someone with a few years of experience in power markets, retail energy, or a related analytical field. You’ll own real decisions early.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a bottoms-up retail pricing model for PJM that builds upon our ERCOT model.

 - Bring PJM into our risk system and P&L reporting, so we know the margin we earn and how to buy supply.

 - Identify new market opportunities and work closely with stakeholders from Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy teams to bring them to reality.

 - Recommend changes to Base’s hedging strategy in ERCOT and PJM, and track our exposure against risk limits.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets knowledge: you understand wholesale market basics in ERCOT and PJM, including how power is bought, hedged and settled. You know how retail pricing and operations work.

 - Commercial sense: you understand how a retail offer makes or loses money. You can explain the cost to supply it, the margin on it, and the risk in between.

 - Risk and statistics: you think in distributions, not point forecasts. You know power prices are tail heavy. Basic statistics is enough.

 - Coding and SQL: you build reports and models in Python (or another language), pull your own data with SQL, and work through a problem independently.

Nice to have: experience at a retail energy provider, utility supply desk, or trading middle office.



ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team’s calls carry real weight - a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base’s book. You’ll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

title: Safety and Abuse Test Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking to grow the safety and abuse team at Base with the addition of a test engineer who will focus on testing our in-house designs up to and past their limits, ensuring the safety of our members and employees is maintained at all times in the product lifecycle.

 

As a member of the safety and abuse team under hardware at Base, you will review new and existing designs, identify issues requiring test coverage, plan, design, and execute said tests, communicating those results effectively to key stakeholders. Some tests are required by governing bodies which we run in-house or at external labs to achieve product compliance. You will also work on increasing test throughput, quality, and generally optimize the spaces we use to run these tests. You will work closely with other test engineers, technicians, and designers.

 

Much of the work will be done at a satellite test laboratory designed, built, and operated by Base, less than an hour’s drive from HQ in Austin Texas (transportation provided). This lab is a primarily outdoor space and applicants can expect to be working hands on. The majority of your time will be spent at this satellite lab during sprints, with time spent in the office as well.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate systems for safety using DFMEA and similar tools

 - Design test setups and execute safety and abuse testing, including but not limited to:
   
   - Thermal runaway testing of batteries
   
   - Short circuit testing of batteries and inverters
   
   - Switch interruption testing (at full voltage)

 - Own the safety of safety/abuse test setups

 - Find and manage space to execute safety and abuse testing

 - Set up data acquisition for all safety/abuse tests, including: thermocouples, voltage or current measurement, accelerometer measurement, etc

 - Write world class test reports
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3 years of designing and running tests on electrical equipment

 - Experience with working around lithium ion batteries / high voltage / DAQ systems

 - Hands on experience with battery thermal runaway is a plus

 - UL 9540 / UL 1973 exposure a plus



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Job Description
The Atlanta Journal-Constitution is one of the most storied brands in journalism, with a legacy that stretches back more than a century. Our mission is to be the most essential and engaging source of news for the people of Atlanta, Georgia and the South, and we have a vision to transform this great institution into a modern media company.
That’s where you come in.
We are looking for a digital-first Associate Video Producer who is excited to build their skills in writing, shooting, producing, editing and, most importantly, telling great stories.
You’ll work alongside experienced producers, journalists and creatives to develop video journalism and explainers across both vertical and horizontal formats. Your work may appear on the AJC’s owned-and-operated platforms as well as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other emerging platforms.
You will have the opportunity to learn from and work alongside some of the most accomplished journalists in the South while helping us establish a bold visual identity and storytelling style that defines the AJC for the next generation. You’ll also have the chance to live, work and play in one of the nation’s most dynamic cities and a major center for film and television production.
A successful candidate has strong storytelling instincts, emerging editorial judgment and a solid foundation in video production. You should be comfortable taking ownership across multiple stages of the production process, from research and pitching through shooting and editing, with guidance from producers and editors as needed, while being eager to develop greater expertise and take on increasing responsibility.
We’re looking for someone who is curious, collaborative and obsessed with getting better. You pay attention to the details, care deeply about quality and accuracy, and are excited to experiment with new formats and creative approaches. Most importantly, you are a team player who is amenable and open to change, evolution, and shifting strategies as we navigate headwinds in the marketplace and changes across our organization.
Some of your job responsibilities:
Research, pitch and produce short-form videos, series, franchises, explainers and documentaries that fit the AJC brand and voice as it continues to evolve
Develop and produce evergreen content that supports the AJC’s broader video strategy
Write creative, compelling and journalistically accurate digital video scripts, incorporating feedback from producers and editors
Manage shoot logistics and production workflows for assigned projects, with producer guidance as needed
Shoot in studio and support studio productions, recording podcast videos, and managing setup and breakdown
Shoot and support live hits in the office for reporters and external partners
Contribute ideas for new video formats, visual approaches and storytelling techniques
Book and coordinate on-camera characters, sources and show guests, with producer support as needed
Participate in on-camera work and/or video narration when appropriate
Shoot in the field using digital cinema cameras and other production equipment while developing a strong understanding of the AJC’s visual identity
Edit radio cuts, rough cuts and, depending on the project, final videos
Collaborate throughout the post-production process with editors, graphic designers, producers and other stakeholders
Incorporate editorial and creative feedback into scripts and edits with accuracy and attention to detail
Maintain internal databases and follow production workflow systems so that footage, projects and other assets are organized and delivered consistently and on deadline
Support the production of stories for sponsored partnerships and revenue-driving initiatives, as directed
Work efficiently in a fast-paced news environment while balancing multiple assignments and deadlines
Stay organized, communicate proactively and adapt quickly as editorial priorities change
Continue developing proficiency across writing, reporting, producing, shooting and editing while taking on increasingly complex productions with appropriate producer oversight
The qualifications and experience you should have:
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 2 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and up to 2years’ experience; or 6 years’ experience in a related field.
A strong foundation in video production and a desire to continue developing a highly skilled, versatile video producer
Working proficiency with post-production software such as Adobe Premiere Pro or similar technology
Experience shooting with professional or prosumer digital video cameras and familiarity with basic lighting and audio techniques
Strong writing skills and demonstrated ability in journalistic and digital video writing
An understanding of the fundamentals of journalism, including accuracy, sourcing and fairness
Strong communication and interpersonal skills and an ability to collaborate effectively with producers, journalists, editors, designers and talent
Experience creating video for digital and/or social platforms
Familiarity with the different storytelling conventions and audience expectations of platforms such as YouTube, Instagram and TikTok
Curiosity about news, culture and the people and stories shaping Atlanta, Georgia and the South
A willingness to experiment, learn new tools and formats, receive feedback and continually improve your craft
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments in a deadline-driven environment
Flexibility and an ability to adapt to changing editorial priorities
A commitment to following the AJC’s editorial standards and practices
Ability to work an extended or flexible schedule when news and production deadlines require it

title: Financial Services Internal Audit Manager
description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
Job Description:
What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
About the Role
Join our Financial Services Consulting practice and help organizations strengthen governance, manage risk, enhance internal controls, and navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment.
As an Internal Audit Manager , you’ll work with banking and financial services clients on meaningful, high-impact engagements spanning internal audit, risk management, internal controls, and compliance. You’ll have the opportunity to lead client engagements, develop and mentor team members, build trusted relationships with client leaders, and recommend practical solutions that improve how organizations manage risk.
This role is ideal for an experienced internal audit professional who enjoys solving complex problems, leading teams, and working directly with clients in an entrepreneurial and collaborative consulting environment.
What You’ll Do
Lead and deliver internal audit, risk management, and internal control engagements for banking and financial services clients.
Plan engagements and manage project teams, including reviewing workpapers and providing coaching, feedback, and guidance to team members.
Conduct and oversee fieldwork, evaluate processes and controls, and develop well-supported conclusions and recommendations.
Communicate findings and observations to client management and prepare clear, actionable reports and presentations.
Advise clients on opportunities to strengthen and optimize internal controls and risk management practices.
Help clients enhance and transform internal audit approaches, methodologies, and operating models.
Perform risk assessments and identify opportunities to improve governance, processes, controls, and compliance.
Manage multiple projects and workstreams while maintaining strong client service and quality standards.
Manage engagement scope, staffing, workplans, budgets, schedules, billing, and overall engagement economics to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget.
Build trusted client relationships and contribute ideas that create additional value for clients and the firm.
Develop and expand relationships with client executives, identify emerging needs, and lead or contribute to proposals, scoping, presentations, and other sales-pursuit activities.
Coach and develop professionals through timely feedback, performance guidance, and career-development support, while holding project teams accountable for their commitments.
Contribute to market and practice growth through thought leadership, professional associations, recruiting, knowledge sharing, and development of new or improved service offerings.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree.
Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification
5+ years of relevant experience in internal audit, internal controls assessment, and/or SOX 404 evaluation and testing, with experience serving organizations in the banking or financial services industry.
Experience managing projects and multiple concurrent workstreams and responsibilities.
Experience supervising, coaching, and reviewing the work of other professionals.
Strong understanding of internal control design and operating effectiveness.
Experience evaluating business processes, process flows, and flowcharts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and internal teams through interviews, meetings, presentations, reports, process narratives, and other formats.
Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability and willingness to travel as needed based on client and engagement requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, or a Business or Economics degree with an Accounting minor or concentration.
Consulting or professional services experience supporting banking and financial services organizations.
Knowledge of GAAP financial accounting and SEC reporting requirements.
Experience advising organizations on internal audit transformation, risk assessments, internal controls optimization, or related risk and governance initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to develop client relationships, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide practical, value-added recommendations.
Experience operating in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where initiative, sound judgment, and effective project leadership are essential.

Customize NetSuite modules, including Financials, CRM, Inventory, and Order Management, to align with client needs.
Develop and implement custom scripts using SuiteScript to extend NetSuite functionality.

Troubleshoot and debug issues in the NetSuite system and custom code.

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted technical advisor.

Provide ongoing support and assistance to clients to ensure successful user adoption.

Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning and status updates.

Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in NetSuite and related technologies.
Continuously improve development skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and self-study.

Follow established development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.
Ensure code quality and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to development processes.

Identify potential technical risks and issues related to NetSuite implementations and assist in developing mitigation strategies.
Monitor and report on the status of technical risks and issues to ensure they are addressed promptly.

Develop a strong understanding of the client's business processes and how they align with NetSuite capabilities.
Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

title: Analyst, Global Operations Center
description:
About the Team
The Global Safety and Security team advances DoorDash through the protection of people, property, operations, brand, and reputation. We deliver value through agility, technology, and a people-first mindset—creating environments where employees and guests feel safe, welcome, and confident.
As DoorDash continues to evolve its workplace experience globally, our Corporate Safety and Security team is reimagining how physical security integrates seamlessly into every employee and guest interaction. The Associate, GOC Analyst will play a key role in designing and delivering this next-generation security experience.
About the Role
We are hiring a GOC Analyst to support DoorDash’s 24/7 Global Operations Center. Reporting to the GOC Manager, this role is responsible for real-time monitoring, incident triage, and operational response to protect DoorDash’s people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will serve as the first line of defense during emerging incidents—monitoring systems, assessing risk, executing SOPs, and escalating issues quickly and accurately. In addition to core operational response, you will apply foundational analytical skills to validate information, distinguish signal from noise, provide clear operational context that supports timely escalation and informed decision-making. You’ll operate in a high-tempo, follow-the-sun environment where clarity, discipline, and sound judgment are critical to maintaining operational resilience.
You are excited about this opportunity because you will…
Operate the GOC in Real Time: Monitor dashboards, alerts, inbound reports, and open-source signals to identify security, safety, and operational incidents as they emerge.
Execute Incident Response with Precision: Triage incidents, follow established SOPs, and support incident command activities through accurate documentation, coordination, and information validation.
Maintain Situational Awareness: Track ongoing incidents, relevant global events, and operational conditions to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of risk across shifts and regions.
Apply Foundational Analytical  Tradecraft: Conduct initial fact-finding, source validation, and contextual analysis to distinguish signal from noise and support effective escalation.
Support Escalation and Decision-Making: Identify when issues exceed defined thresholds and escalate to the GOC Manager or Risk Intelligence team with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation.
Ensure Seamless Shift Handover: Produce concise shift reports and conduct disciplined handovers that capture incident status, risk context, and outstanding actions.
Contribute to Operational Excellence: Participate in drills, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen GOC readiness, workflows, and analytical rigor.
Operate Calmly Under Pressure: Demonstrate professionalism, composure, and sound judgment during fast-moving or high-impact incidents.
We are excited about you because you bring…
Operations Center Experience: 3+ years in a GSOC, GOC, SOC, or comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment.
Incident Management Fundamentals: Working knowledge of incident triage, escalation protocols, and operational playbooks.
Foundational Analytical Skills: Ability to assess information quality, identify trends or anomalies, and provide clear operational context during incidents.
Basic OSINT Familiarity: Comfort using open-source tools and publicly available information to validate events and support situational awareness (training provided as needed).
Strong Operational Judgment: Ability to assess risk, prioritize tasks, and act decisively under pressure.
Technical Fluency: Comfort working across monitoring dashboards, ticketing systems, communication platforms, and basic analytics tools.
Clear Communication Skills: Ability to document incidents clearly and communicate effectively with leaders and cross-functional partners.
Discipline and Reliability: Proven ability to follow process, maintain attention to detail, and perform consistently across rotating shifts.
Growth Mindset: Willingness to learn new tools, analytical techniques, and operational best practices within a structured operations environment.
Schedule Flexibility: Ability to work rotating shifts as part of a 24/7 global operations model.
Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent professional or military experience.

location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, SF; Chicago, IL; Washington, D.C., Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, LA; Phoenix, AZ
description:
About the Team
The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce by expanding DoorDash beyond restaurants. We help customers get the groceries, convenience items, alcohol, retail, and other essentials they need, when they need them.
The Consumer Growth team sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, product, and marketing. We identify the biggest opportunities to grow New Verticals, develop the strategies to pursue them, and bring them to life through customer-facing launches, campaigns, and product experiences.
About the Role
We’re looking for an Associate Manager to lead Consumer Growth GTM strategy for New Verticals. This person will shape how we bring priority merchants, categories, and customer behaviors to market, with a focus on bringing structure to a high volume of GTM opportunities and helping teams prioritize and execute them efficiently.
You will own the business strategy behind major growth moments: defining the customer opportunity, sizing the potential, recommending where to invest, setting goals, and translating insights into clear GTM plans. You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Business Development to ensure our plans are both strategically sound and operationally executable.
This is a highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable digging into data, developing a point of view, and driving alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders. You will manage a portfolio of initiatives with varying levels of complexity and make clear recommendations about where DoorDash should focus its limited resources for the greatest customer and business impact.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own Consumer Growth GTM strategy. Lead strategy development for priority New Verticals growth moments, including merchant launches, category expansion, seasonal occasions, affordability initiatives, and product launches. Define the customer problem, business opportunity, target audience, value proposition, and path to impact.
Set investment and customer strategy. Develop frameworks to prioritize GTM investments and determine the right level of support across initiatives. Create scalable playbooks for customer targeting, including audience strategy, targeting principles, and measurement approaches.
Turn data into action. Build analyses and models using SQL and Excel to assess customer behavior, business performance, incrementality, and return on investment. Develop test-and-learn plans and translate results into clear recommendations for what we should do next.
Lead cross-functional execution. Partner with Integrated Marketing, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product, Analytics, Finance, Partnerships, and Operations to bring strategies to market. Align teams on goals, audiences, measurement, timelines, risks, and decisions.
Build the operating system for GTM. Bring rigor and structure to a high volume of growth opportunities. Create clear prioritization frameworks, repeatable playbooks, planning cadences, and decision mechanisms that help teams move faster and focus resources on the highest-impact initiatives. This role rewards operational rigor: ensuring the highest-impact activations are prioritized, well scoped, and efficiently executed.
We’re excited about you because you have…
4+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, growth, business operations, product strategy, investment banking, or a related analytical and cross-functional environment.
Exceptional organizational and program-management skills. You can take a large, ambiguous set of requests and opportunities, create structure around them, and turn them into a clear, actionable plan.
Experience building scalable frameworks, playbooks, and operating processes that make cross-functional teams faster and more effective.
Strong judgment and prioritization skills. You know how to distinguish between what is urgent, what is impactful, and what does not need to happen.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust across teams, influence senior stakeholders, and navigate competing priorities with sound judgment. You know when to drive alignment, when to push back, and how to articulate a clear point of view while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
Strong analytical skills, including comfort independently pulling data in SQL and building models in Excel. You use data to develop a point of view and make clear recommendations, not just report findings.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
An operationally minded, low-ego approach. You are comfortable with ambiguity, willing to get into the details, and energized by bringing structure to complex work.
A completed Bachelor’s degree.
Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…
We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

description:
About the Team
DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager with an ML background to lead the Personalization engineering team. This team is responsible for building ML ranking and recommendation systems to maximize the value for consumers, merchants, and DoorDash.
Our Personalization team is a part of our Core Consumer org which owns the top of the conversion funnel from the initial landing page all the way to checkout across platforms. Personalization is at the center of the team’s mission. As DoorDash expands into new verticals and experiences like grocery, reservations, and going out, the challenge of helping consumers easily find what they want grows exponentially, so the opportunity is massive!

description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike.  We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact.  We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries.  As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries.  We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better
About the Role
We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to develop and improve chassis systems and vehicle dynamics performance for DOT, DoorDash’s autonomous delivery robot. You’ll combine hands-on mechanical design, engineering analysis, and vehicle testing to improve existing platforms and develop suspension and chassis solutions for future projects.
You’ll own engineering work from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype evaluation, and validation. Working closely with internal teams and suppliers, you’ll assess designs, resolve technical challenges, and ensure chassis systems meet our performance, durability, and integration requirements.
This role offers the opportunity to influence how DOT rides, handles, brakes, and traverses real-world terrain while improving the reliability and serviceability of our deployed robots.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design and improve suspension and chassis systems , including suspension geometry, linkages, wheel-end assemblies, and drivetrain and brake mounting interfaces.
Own mechanical design execution , developing concepts, detailed CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerance analyses to support prototype builds and production release.
Sustain and improve existing platforms , investigating field issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing validated engineering changes.
Define chassis and vehicle dynamics requirements for ride quality, traction, braking, stability, ground clearance, and obstacle traversal across terrain and payload conditions.
Provide technical oversight of supplier-developed hardware , reviewing designs, analyses, and test results to ensure systems meet vehicle requirements and integrate successfully.
Develop and execute verification and validation plans with reliability, test, and integration teams, establishing measurable acceptance criteria for components and complete vehicles.
Lead instrumented vehicle dynamics testing , analyze results, and translate findings into hardware improvements and operating limits.
Partner with controls and autonomy engineers to characterize vehicle capabilities and improve motion performance.
Support prototype builds, manufacturing, and service teams , resolving integration issues and improving durability, manufacturability, and maintainability .
We’re excited about you because…
You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
You have experience designing and developing suspension, chassis, or related mechanical systems for vehicles or mobile robots.
You understand suspension kinematics, load transfer, tire behavior, stiffness and damping, braking, and vehicle stability—and can apply these fundamentals to hardware design.
You are proficient in NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or a comparable CAD platform and have experience releasing detailed mechanical designs.
You apply sound engineering judgment to load cases, structural integrity, fatigue, bearings, bolted joints, materials, and manufacturing processes.
You can independently assess designs and analyses, identify technical risks, and drive issues to resolution with internal teams and suppliers.
You have hands-on experience with prototype assembly, instrumentation, vehicle testing, and root cause analysis.
You can translate requirements into test methods and acceptance criteria, then use Python, MATLAB, or similar tools to evaluate results.
You take ownership from initial investigation through implementation and verification
